newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO trying to free Israelis besieged in Nablus.
newsitem.headline: PLO trying to free Israelis besieged in Nablus.

text.p: Angry Palestinian demonstrators besieged Israelis at a shrine in the West Bank town of Nablus and the PLO was trying to free them, Palestinian officials said on Thursday.

They said Israel deployed armoured personnel carriers in the area after Palestinian demonstrators burned several Israeli jeeps used by soldiers to try to rescue the Israelis from the traditional tomb of the biblical Joseph.
Earlier, Israeli army radio said two Israeli soldiers were killed in battles with Palestinians at the site.

"About 40 Israeli military personnel and civilians are besieged at the Tomb of the Prophet Yousef and we are trying to get them out," an official at the Palestinian governorate of Nablus said of the incident.
He said Palestinian police were trying to enforce a curfew on the area around the site to allow the Israelis to leave safely.

Under a self-rule deal which expanded Palestinian self-rule in the West Bank, Israel kept control of the shrine, which is holy to Jews and Moslems. Yasser Arafat's Palestinian Authority controls the rest of the city of 130,000 Arabs.
Israel Radio said 10 Israeli soldiers guarding the tomb were besieged and confirmed that efforts to rescue them had failed.

"At Joseph's Tomb, near Nablus, there is a fierce fight...An attempt to break in and rescue the forces from Joseph's Tomb didn't go well and during it several Israeli army jeeps went up in flames," the radio said.
One Palestinian witness said he saw at least three jeeps gutted by fire.
Israel had massed several armoured personnel carriers and helicopters and were negotiating with local PLO officials to free them.
